groups.name: Lost execute response after actual begin record
groups.oracle: One executeAudit send fails response; current wire owner detail has exact original public record/action metadata/current worker. recoverExecution true; exact executionRef copied; stale and uncertain executeAudit unchanged; zero recovery RPC; collect/finish not fabricated.

groups.name: Disconnect during execute
groups.oracle: Deferred executeAudit then disconnected; task wire snapshot restored fresh with exact record. Late old response ignored; recovered reference only; execute count remains one.

groups.name: Disconnect after response loss
groups.oracle: Existing executeAudit uncertainty survives disconnect and reconnect/status refresh; recovery yields exact reference and does not clear uncertainty or grant resend.

groups.name: Finite ambiguity and bounds
groups.oracle: For each actions/workers/executions: missing array, empty matching rows, duplicate matching rows, 129 rows; reject recovery with execution null and zero RPC.

groups.name: Exact identity discriminator matrix
groups.oracle: Change each of 13 expected execution bindings independently, including task/action/digest/claim/gen/session/input ref+digest/audit/binding/material/purpose/action executionRef; reject. Also change each current worker six identity refs and action claim/gen.

groups.name: Closed required schema
groups.oracle: Delete each of 19 required execution keys; add unknown key or RPC-only admitted/deduplicated; reject. Malformed all 14 ref keys and semanticRevision/createdAt fail.

groups.name: Actual optional fields
groups.oracle: Accept absent optional keys; valid admittedAt/resultRef/reportRef/outcomeEvidenceRef/nullable terminalEvidenceRef from public records. Reject admittedAt before createdAt/noninteger, dispatch_intent without admittedAt, bad optional refs, foreign resultRef, reportRef without resultRef. No captured state accepted.

groups.name: Current snapshot freshness
groups.oracle: Task stale or selected task/version/auth mismatch; audit busy; disposed model; absent retained input/action/worker or uncertainty not executeAudit; refuse and preserve state.

groups.name: Task switch and old response
groups.oracle: Switch to distinct task clears retained mappings/uncertainty; old task snapshot candidates cannot recover. Settled old delayed response never adopts worker/execution; no repeat sends.

groups.name: Read-only UI and host result boundary
groups.oracle: Stale audit card enables only matching recovery alongside safe query; collect remains disabled until explicit status refresh. Terminal/resultRef/reportRef observed in execution never populates collection or enables finish. Explicit collect RPC uses recovered original ref and actual current CAS; only its separately scripted real-format wire response updates collection.

groups.name: No replay and no second adoption
groups.oracle: Recover twice: first true, second false. Before and after status refresh create/execute remain zero additional sends. Conflicting later execution candidate cannot replace retained execution through recovery.

groups.name: Historical typed fields
groups.oracle: dataDigest differs from inputDigest and semanticRevision differs from current detail.semanticRevision: valid typed historical values remain observable; do not manufacture artifact digest/current revision equality. Stored commandRef remains verbatim and is never generated by recovery.
